text:
sam: Heads-up — found an edge case in the embeddings route. Clients send mixed-dim arrays that individually fit but together blow the per-request byte budget. Console preflight shows success but runtime returns 413s. Anyone seen this?

marta: Yep, saw it in logs earlier. Usually 1x512 + 1x1536 + metadata -> total > 10MB. Our preflight only checks per-item dims. We should either preflight total bytes or enforce chunking.

kevin: My proposal: add an X-Embed-Total-Bytes preflight header that SDKs set. Server rejects early with 413 + suggested split. Keeps runtime from spinning up expensive slots.

eli: I'd prefer server-side compute of total bytes to avoid relying on client libs. We already stream/read the body to route; record metric embed.preflight_total_bytes and a preflight_reject counter.

marta: Server compute works but can be expensive on big streams. We already read body for routing, but need to ensure console surfaces rejected payloads so customers can debug (no cryptic 413).

kevin: Console UX idea: show a "payload budget" hint on the embeddings route page. Display max_request_bytes and percent_of_quota for the last 7d. Quick callout for common split strategies.

sam: Also routing question: if total bytes > slot_size, should we fallback to a larger shard pool instead of rejecting? Route to high-memory pool when available.

eli: Fallback could be enabled but risky for cost. Proposed policy: if tenant has burst credits -> route to large-pool; otherwise reject with guidance link. Telemetry must tag decisions.

ops-bot: deploy started: embed-preflight-total-bytes v1 -> staging :rocket:

marta: Telemetry note: record the fallback_chosen flag so finance can measure spend uplift and we can set regression alerts on spend per-tenant.

sam: Also update quota accounting. We currently count token-ish units; for embeddings we should count bytes (or a hybrid bytes*dim metric). Otherwise customers can bypass quotas by sending wide floats.

kevin: I'll draft the API change + error shape. Server check + early rejection is straightforward. Marta/Eli take console + telemetry.

marta: I'll file console ticket: "Embed: per-request bytes + top offenders" and add a small dashboard widget with 95p request bytes.

eli: Sample preflight rejection response we can use in docs:

```
HTTP/1.1 413 Payload Too Large
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "error": "embed_request_too_large",
  "max_request_bytes": 10485760,
  "your_request_bytes": 12457890,
  "suggested_split_strategy": "split-by-total-bytes"
}
```
I'll add this to the API spec.

sam: SDK change: add an auto-splitter that uses a client-side prefer_split header and falls back to server recommendations. Need to maintain backcompat for older SDKs.

kevin: Timeline?

marta: Figma console mocks by EOD. Eli + Kevin aim to have staging tests by Thursday.

sam: Great. Please post staging perf numbers here after the run (latency, rejection rate, and any spend delta).
